text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — Zenith POC call 09:00 PT tomorrow. Sales wants a committed throughput proposal for MLP feature: target 350 rps steady, 1.2k rps bursts (30s). Need reserved GPU recommendation + autoscale fallback plan. Also security questionnaire deadline EOD.
samir: Do we have their expected request size / avg tokens per request? That changes batching/throughput.
elaine: They said avg 120 tokens in, 350 tokens out. 10% of requests are multi-turn (context carried ~4 turns).
jordan: Ok rough calc: 350 steady * 350 avg tokens = ~122.5k tokens/sec generated, plus prompts. On A100 perf that's heavy. For predictable SLAs recommend 2x reserved GPUs (p4d equivalent) + 1 burst slot.
marta: If we give 2 reserved nodes, what's tail latency at 95% with our default batching? Need to keep <600ms for single-turn, <1.2s for multi-turn.
jordan: With conservative batching (max batch 32, timeout 8ms) we should hit ~450ms p95 single-turn on quantized model q4_0 variant. Multi-turn will be ~900-1,100ms depending on KV cache hits.
elaine: Pricing question from sales: customer will commit monthly. They want delta cost if we add dedicated prewarm (keeps KV cache hot) vs pure reserved + burst credits. Thoughts?
samir: Prewarm (persistent warm cache) reduces tail substantially but costs ~15% uplift on monthly reserved price. For Zenith's profile (10% multi-turn) it's borderline but helps burst spikes. Recommend optional prewarm as add-on.
marta: Also flag AZ spread for resilience — they asked about AZ failover. For reserved pools we should place across 2 AZs and allow burst from region pool. Note this affects prewarm effectiveness.
jordan: Autoscale policy suggestion: keep base=2 reserved, max=5 with cooldown 60s, prewarm window 5m for scheduled events. Fallback policy: if autoscale cannot allocate, route to cheaper quantized model (q4_0 -> q2_k) with warning header and degrade length to 300 tokens.
elaine: Can someone draft the short bullet list I can put in the SOW? Need throughput, latency SLOs, reserved count, autoscale settings, and contingency fallback.
samir: I'll draft. Quick bullets: - Committed throughput: 350 rps steady, 1.2k rps 30s bursts; - Reserved: 2 GPUs (p4d equiv); - Autoscale: max 5, scale cooldown 60s, burst credits for 2 minutes; - Prewarm: optional +15% cost; - Fallback: quantized model with length cap; - AZ spread: 2 AZs with cross-AZ burst policy.
marta: Add operational items: KV cache warmup plan (run 300 synthetic warmups per model on rollout), smoke test (2k synthetic reqs at 80% load), and monitoring hooks (per-route latency and token spend).
jordan: Also add rollback in SOW: can revert to hosted baseline model for up to 30 mins if regressions found.
elaine: Security questionnaire bits: they asked about KMS/HSM for keys and audit logs retention 90 days. We support KMS and can enable audit export. Need to attach checklist to SOW.
marta: I'll grab the standard KMS blurb and attach.
sales-bot: @elaine reminder: Attach pricing table from 2026-03 pricing sheet: https://redwood.internal/pricing/2026-q1
elaine: Thanks — I'll combine Samir's bullets + Marta's ops items + security blurb and post final by 5pm PT today.
devops-bot: Deploy smoke harness scheduled: run at 2026-03-25T15:00Z — results to #eng-sre.
jordan: One last note — for the SOW numbers include risk buffer of +20% capacity for first 30 days to account for misestimation. Call that out in the runbook.
elaine: Great. If no objections I'll send draft to sales and security now. :thumbsup:
